subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): failed raw channel sends report success

question: Should legacy raw channel-send adapters reject provider `ok: false` responses as delivery failures while the public normalization helper continues to return normalized failed results for direct callers?
rationale: The code and regression coverage make the boundary behavior mechanically clear, but selecting the long-term Plugin SDK failure contract is a maintainer compatibility decision.

options.title: Approve the adapter contract
options.body: Accept rejected promises for failed legacy raw sends, preserving the public helper’s direct-call compatibility as this branch does.

options.title: Keep legacy resolved failures
options.body: Retain resolved `{ ok: false }` adapter results if existing raw-plugin callers are expected to inspect failure objects directly.

recommendation.title: Approve the adapter contract
recommendation.body: Accept rejected promises for failed legacy raw sends, preserving the public helper’s direct-call compatibility as this branch does.
